description.value:
Ability Scores: Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.feats.Item.phbftLucky000000]{Lucky}

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Persuasion

Tool Proficiency: Navigator’s Tools

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulNavigators]{Navigator’s Tools}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagPouch000000]{Pouches}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler’s Clothes}, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP

You were apprenticed to a trader, caravan master, or shopkeeper, learning the fundamentals of commerce. You traveled broadly, and you earned a living by buying and selling the raw materials artisans need to practice their craft or finished works from such crafters. You might have transported goods from one place to another (by ship, wagon, or caravan) or bought them from traveling traders and sold them in your own shop.

advancement.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Constitution, Intelligence, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Background Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you proficiency in Animal Handling and Persuasion. It also grants proficiency with Navigator's Tools.

advancement.title: Background Feat
advancement.hint: Your backgrounds grants you the Lucky feat.

advancement.title: Choose Languages
advancement.hint: Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table.
